achievements.unlocked_text: The Tablet of Second Death is whole.

achievements.name: A Shimmer in the Dark
achievements.hint: Something in the dungeon shimmers that does not belong to it.
achievements.unlocked_text: You found the Abyssal Shimmer.

achievements.name: Haunted by Myself
achievements.hint: In the oldest dungeon games, the dead leave ghosts for whoever comes next.
achievements.unlocked_text: You met the ghost of a hero you once were.

achievements.name: Behind the Curtain
achievements.unlocked_text: Pay no attention to the person behind the curtain.

achievements.name: Not Dead Yet
achievements.unlocked_text: Your hero was not dead yet. Not quite.

achievements.name: Thirty Lives
achievements.hint: Up, up, down, down...
achievements.unlocked_text: Up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B, A. Old games remember.

achievements.name: Nice Try
achievements.hint: There is only one Dad.
achievements.unlocked_text: Nice try.

achievements.name: A Hollow Voice
achievements.hint: Some hints are written in Caesar's hand.
achievements.unlocked_text: A hollow voice says, "Plugh."
